title: fix: show agent pricing only in agent category
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Shows the agent-specific pricing note only when the Agent category is selected.
- Keeps the shared `/gen`, token, duration, and usage legends visible across model categories.
- Fixes the unconditional footer rendering without adding state or new components.

Checks:
- `npx biome check --write enter.pollinations.ai/frontend/src/components/models/models.tsx`
- `npm run typecheck` in `enter.pollinations.ai`

gist.headline: Legends know their place
gist.blurb: The model picker footer stopped bringing agent-only pricing notes to every category party. Shared usage details still bloom exactly where they belong.
gist.summary: Fixed the models UI so the agent-specific pricing note renders only for the Agent category, while the shared /gen, token, duration, and usage legends remain visible across categories.
gist.impact: Users browsing image, text, audio, or other model categories now see the relevant shared pricing guidance without an unrelated agent pricing footer.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-selection garden with clearly labeled category tabs; Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, gently moves an Agent-only price placard into a small Agent flowerbed while shared /gen, token, duration, and usage signs remain visible along every garden path.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush and light blue wings, wearing tiny librarian glasses as she places an "AGENT" pricing sign only beside one labeled garden bed; shared little signs for "/gen", "TOKENS", "DURATION", and "USAGE" line all the other paths. Lime green (#ecf874) glows prominently among pastel flowers and code-plants, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
